sourceReferences.meaning: Compute own/allied player BITSET then pass it as fourth UN:H argument on every hero movement; iterate eachlevel.

report.conclusion: The provided native UN:H fourth parameter is a PLAYER INDEX to preserve (with all equal-team players), NOT a bitmask. Source77 passes its precomputed bitset into this index decoder, and that composition must be preserved for strict source fidelity. UN:H clears fog player bits outside the decoded preserved team within a circular radius, then immediately re-reveals sight from owned heroes/towns/other structures for ALL owners and both levels before returning. Screen paint timing is not established.

nativeContract.signature: UN:H(x,y,z,p,r); p is preservedPlayerIndex, despite source77 variable being named playersBitSet.
nativeContract.decode: uint16 keep=0x0100; if0<=signedp<8: forj0..7, if signedbyte(team[j])==signedbyte(team[p]): keep|=1<<j. Ifp==-1 or any other out-of-range value, keep=0x0100. Equality is literal: native loop does not exclude negative/unassigned team labels.
nativeContract.mutation: For each included(xi,yi,z): oldFogWord replaced by oldFogWord & keep. Thus low8 bits of all players outside preserved equal-team set are cleared; selected team old bits are preserved, not newly revealed. Exact operation also preserves bit8 and clears other upper bits. Meaning of upper bits was not re-proven.
nativeContract.radius: Normal nonnegative radius and valid coordinates: xi∈[max(0,x-r),min(width-1,x+r)], yi similarly height; include iff sqrt((xi-x)^2+(yi-y)^2)<=r+0.5. Squaring/sum use int32 IMUL/ADD then x87 sqrt. Ordinarymap dimensions avoidoverflow. r=0 includes center; r=1 includes diagonals because sqrt2<=1.5.
nativeContract.level: Hide49d040 only selected z. Subsequent4c7910 owned-sight pass processes all heroes/structures, including otherlevels; source77 calls UN:H separately for eachmaplevel.
nativeContract.refreshOrder: Visibility words are updated synchronously during49d040; changedtile old/new deltas are queued through GameMgr+4e7ac. The UN bridge then calls4c7910 immediately, which OR-reveals equal-team sight of every eligible owned object. This is visibility recomputation, not proof of synchronous screen rendering or network consumption timing.
